title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The last practice
hook: What will your team do at the last practice of the season?
intro: Kids want to play their favorite games.
statement: The last practice is a chance to end on joy.
q1: Do you make the last practice all favorites —
q2: or run a normal practice to the end?
q3: What do you want them to remember?
t1: Both can work. But kids sign up again
t2: when the season ends on something they loved.
cta: Coaches — what is your last practice like?
ctaLines: Favorite games. Kids versus coaches. A normal practice.
ctaPrompt: Share your last practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What will your team do at the last practice of the season?
The final practice is here. Kids want to play their favorite games.
The last practice is a chance to end on joy.
All favorites or a normal practice. There is no perfect answer.
What is your last practice like? Share your habit in the comments.
